acceptanceCriteria.text: AC1: Returning/non-gathering squad holding needed heroes returns null from recallForQueue() instead of false error
AC2: returnMs() falls back to options.center and returnToOutpost.to.coordinates when experimentalMapContext center is missing
AC3: No unnecessary gathering recall when needed is empty and a march is already returning to outpost
AC4: Unit tests pass (npm test 0 fail) and npm run build succeeds

checkpointPayload.description: Fix recallForQueue() and returnMs() in smartGather.ts so returning/in-combat squads do not trigger false 'No gathering squad with known coordinates can release the required slot/heroes' errors, add center coordinate fallbacks, and guard waiting_gather timeout in advanceGatherQueue().
checkpointPayload.title: P1-15 Fix Raid/Monster Queue Stuck on Gathering Recall Error
